scope: Source preview clock correctness only; read-only source and existing browser evidence, pure Node VM controls, no browser, capture, FFmpeg, cache mutation, source change or listening-quality claim

finding.title: Audible source preview advances pictures on a different clock from its soundtrack
finding.trigger: Enable sound, select a cue and press Play while audio playback starts asynchronously, or while audio subsequently buffers/stalls
finding.cause: Play records performance.now() and starts the picture RAF chain immediately. tick computes first + floor(elapsedPerformanceTime * fps), independently of audio.currentTime and the pending audio.play() promise.
finding.impact: Sound contacts cannot be judged against the displayed native frame reliably. Startup delay remains as a picture lead after audio begins, later audio stalls increase that lead, and Pause can retain the wrong picture/audio relationship. This violates the timed live cue audition requirement.
finding.smallestFix: For enabled sound, derive tick's native frame target from floor(audio.currentTime * fps). Keep the current performance clock for explicit silent playback. Preserve draw serialization, playback-generation checks, active-failure handling and the existing native ending behavior.
finding.whyAwaitingPlayAloneIsInsufficient: Waiting only for audio.play() fulfillment removes an initial startup offset but does not follow later buffering or other media-clock stalls. The media timeline must remain the playback authority while sound is enabled.

existingActualBrowserEvidence.qualification: Its existing PASS records control progression/pause, and does not establish clock alignment. The recorded native frame and media time themselves demonstrate the defect.

pureVmControl.implementation: Execute the script returned by previewPage in node:vm with a mock DOM, controlled performance clock, manually delivered RAF callbacks, immediate shader frame seeks and a deferred audio.play promise. Reuse the DOM shape from motionLaunchProject.test.ts:94-138. No source file was modified.

requiredVerificationForFix: Demonstrate a new regression fails against the reviewed 3ce369 source: pending audio.play must not advance picture beyond the media-clock frame despite a 300ms RAF clock advance.
Resolve play, advance media time, then hold media time while advancing RAF by one second; pictures must follow and then hold the media-clock frame.
Retain silent wall-clock advancement, cue-seek waiting, prior-generation callback rejection, ordinary pause cancellation, active audio failure and native-end controls.

Sample native frame plus audio.currentTime during actual audible preview and after pause. Explicitly assess clock alignment; document any asynchronous rendering lag rather than treating movement alone as an alignment PASS.
